name: Hotel Chinzanso Tokyo
accessSummary: Edogawabashi Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line) Exit 1a: about 10 min walk / Waseda Station (Tokyo Metro Tozai Line) Exit 3a: about 20 min walk / Waseda Station (Toden Arakawa Line): about 14 min walk

rooms.name: Banquet Bldg. 5F - Grand Hall TSUBAKI
rooms.note: Permanent stage 18 m x 6 m. The hall can be divided in half and used as a medium-sized banquet hall. A large lift allows exhibitions such as automobiles. Separate lobby of about 400㎡.

rooms.name: Banquet Bldg. 4F - TSUZUMI (5 rooms)
rooms.note: Areas: TSUZUMI 1 and 2 (can be divided) 181㎡, TSUZUMI 3 158㎡, TSUZUMI 5 69㎡, TSUZUMI 6 53㎡, TSUZUMI 7 38㎡. The seated 20 and standing 50 are the figures in the official list.

ops.loadingHours: Large items can also be loaded in by truck. Grand Hall TSUBAKI has a large lift, so exhibitions of items such as automobiles are also possible.
ops.parking: The car park has 300 spaces. The fee is 500 yen per 30 minutes (the first 30 minutes from entry are free). Banquet and meeting attendees get 8 hours free. Valet parking is also available at the Hotel Building (a notice says the car park fees and services will be revised from October 1, 2026).
ops.waitingRooms: TSUZUMI on the 4F of the Banquet Building (5 rooms, 38 to 181㎡) can also be used as waiting rooms when other banquet halls are in use. There are men's and women's changing rooms on the 4F of the Hotel Building and the B1F of the Banquet Building.
ops.catering: Banquet food is prepared by the hotel (Western, Japanese, and Chinese cuisine featuring medicinal recipes are available). Catering that delivers the hotel's food outside the venue is accepted year-round on weekdays only.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has 8 restaurants in total, including a ryotei, Japanese cuisine, Italian, stone-grilled cuisine, and a lounge. The hotel says its private rooms with a view of the garden can also be used for dinners after meetings and similar occasions.
